own_policy.success: Commit once, discard current draft only after persistence, then fresh input using current registered defaults and selected own form defaults. Modal rekeys to same context new draft and updates title/baseline.
own_policy.failure: Validation, localStorage failure, permission loss or stale existing edit retains original controls, database and current identity.
own_policy.separate_pending_draft: Before any save, block SaveNew from existing modal if another new draft is already retained for same base route; it remains accessible through New. Save or explicitly reset that draft before retry.
own_policy.source_provenance: Saved linked/generated voucher retains sourceId/sourceLineId/planGeneration/planAllocations. Next fresh document has no inherited source links and normal editable controls.
own_policy.reset_fix: Existing modal Reset failed to rebase baseline, so later close could recreate empty pending draft. After confirmed reset now establishes fresh baseline/dirty=false; rejection leaves fields intact.
own_policy.menu: Plan only SaveRetain/SaveNew, no unobserved approval option; others retain three observed options with external approval disabled.
own_policy.barcode_boundary: Original generic new action keeps specific barcode options; exact mapping to own helper state and original generic field-reset policy unverified. Own fresh/current-default behavior is explicit, not original field parity.
